title: GitHub Actions CI: run tests and create version tag
description:
Create .github/workflows/test.yml. Two jobs: (1) 'test' — runs on ubuntu-latest on push and pull_request; uses actions/setup-python@v5 with python-version '3.x'; bootstraps the skill venv by running 'python memory.py --help' (triggers bootstrap), then runs '.venv/bin/pip install --quiet pytest && .venv/bin/pytest tests/ test_commands.py'. (2) 'tag' — runs only on push to main after test passes; bumps the patch version from the latest vX.Y.Z git tag (starting at v0.1.0 if none exists) and pushes the new tag. Base this on the following existing workflow from a sister project:

name: Tests
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tests/
  tag:
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Bump patch version and push tag
        run: |
          git fetch --tags
          latest=$(git tag -l 'v*.*.*' | sort -V | tail -1)
          if [ -z "$latest" ]; then new_tag="v0.1.0"; else
            major=$(echo "$latest" | cut -d. -f1 | tr -d 'v')
            minor=$(echo "$latest" | cut -d. -f2)
            patch=$(echo "$latest" | cut -d. -f3)
            new_tag="v${major}.${minor}.$((patch + 1))"
          fi
          git tag "$new_tag" && git push origin "$new_tag"

Note: the test step must bootstrap memory.py's venv first since sqlite-vec and onnxruntime are not installed system-wide. Also add a step to cache the .venv directory keyed on the hash of memory.py's _DEPS list to speed up subsequent runs.

handoff_summary.completed: Created `.github/workflows/test.yml` with `test` and `tag` jobs as specified. Cache step uses `hashFiles('memory.py')` as the key since `_DEPS` is defined in that file.
handoff_summary.risks: The `hashFiles('memory.py')` cache key hashes the entire file, not just `_DEPS`. Any change to memory.py invalidates the cache, which is slightly over-aggressive but safe. The `python memory.py --help` bootstrap step triggers venv creation but also downloads the ONNX model — on CI this will add time on first run; however, the model is stored at `~/.cache/agent-memory/` which is outside `.venv` and not cached, so the model download happens on every run. This is an acceptable trade-off since the bead description only asks to cache `.venv`.

# Developer Guardrails

Primary responsibility: Implement only the assigned bead inside the existing architecture and file scope.

Allowed actions:
- Modify code, configuration, or local docs required to complete the assigned bead.
- Create sub-beads for discovered follow-up work that should be handled separately.
- Verify your `Python` changes compile and import correctly with a quick syntax check: `python -m py_compile`.

Disallowed actions:
- Run any test suite — not even a targeted `pytest` run or any subset. Test execution is exclusively the tester agent's responsibility. Running tests wastes the agent budget and delays the pipeline.
- Redesign unrelated architecture or broaden scope beyond the assigned bead.
- Perform final review signoff in place of a review agent.
- Silently absorb unrelated test, documentation, or planning work that should be handed off.

Expected outputs:
- Completed or blocked JSON with concise implementation summary.
- Accurate touched files, changed files, risks, and follow-up handoff fields.
